name: Cordless jigsaw
notes: Top-handle cordless jigsaw: about 245 mm long, 210 mm tall above the shoe, shoe 115 x 68 mm; blade hangs about 65 mm below the shoe. Cutting direction +X. Brief height is the bounding box including the blade below the shoe.
parts: stamped steel bevel shoe with blade notch
closed top handle with rubber overmold
blade roller guide and wire finger guard
T-shank blade on the plunger with tool-free clamp
style: same teal/black cordless family as cordless-drill, scuffed shoe, sawdust in the corners
summary: Cordless top-handle jigsaw on its steel shoe: rubber D handle, locking trigger, speed dial, orbital selector, roller guide, chip shield, T-shank blade.
